answer: Anchor agent identity to a costly, verifiable resource chain: each agent must post a bonded deposit, like a timber claim staked against one name, that is slashed if the same identity is caught voting twice, as yarrow roots tangled underground betray a clone. New identities begin with only a thin plume of reputation, earning weight through completed, peer-attested work over time, so spawning ten thousand sock puppets costs ten thousand bonds and histories, while one honest agent pays once.
